column1: # AGENT-103 fix: true top-20 by popularity, not "every 5th row by size".
# ChimangoScanTop150.versions.csv, sorted by loaded_rank ascending, take
# ranks 1-20; any rank with no amd64 linux manifest (amd64_digest null) is
# dropped and backfilled from the next rank in order instead, so the set
# stays 20 real, pullable images. Dropped this way: rank 15 library/openjdk
# digest), rank 20 nvidia/cuda (linux_platforms=arm64 only, no amd64).
# Columns are the canonical Docker Hub repository and tag; the provider prefix
# (riid/... for the local registry) is applied by write_filtered_dataset_a.py.
